name: Khan Dez'hepah's Head
summary: Khan Dez'hepah's Head is proof that the Kolkar leader has been defeated. Felgur Twocuts wants it as a show of strength against the centaur clans.

sections.title: Proof of Strength
sections.body: Across Desolace, the centaur clans fight among themselves. Felgur Twocuts fears they would be a fierce foe if they united, so he sends you to disrupt the Kolkar by defeating their leader, Khan Dez'hepah. His head is the proof Felgur asks you to bring back.

faq.answer: Felgur Twocuts asks you to bring Khan Dez'hepah's Head to him in Desolace.

faq.q: Why does Felgur want the head?
faq.answer: Felgur wants to disrupt the Kolkar clan and show strength to the centaur clans of Desolace.
Khan Dez'hepah was the leader of the Kolkar clan in Desolace.

faq.q: Where can I find Khan Dez'hepah?
faq.answer: Khan Dez'hepah is at Kolkar Village, northeast of Felgur Twocuts.
